name: _speeches
strings: % attempted to communicate with the Ogre but a guttural snarl was the only response.
"Human must die!" said the goblin-man.
"Doom!" wailed the wraith.
A clattering of bones was the only reply.
% knew that it is a waste of time to talk to a snake.
There was no reply.
"Die, foolish mortal!" he said.
"No need to shout, son!" he said.
"Nice weather we're having, isn't it?" queried the ranger.
"Good luck, sonny!" said the ranger. "Hope you win!"
"If you need to cross the lake" said the ranger, "There's a raft just north of here."
"Would you like to buy something?" said the tavern keeper. "Or do you just need lodging for the night?"
"Good Morning." said the tavern keeper. "Hope you slept well."
"Have a drink!" said the tavern keeper."
"State your business!" said the guard."My business is with the king." stated %, respectfully.
"Please, sir, rescue me from this horrible prison!" pleaded the princess.
"I cannot help you, young man." said the king. "My armies are decimated, and I fear that with the loss of my children, I have lost all hope."
"Here is a writ designating you as my official agent. Be sure and show this to the Priest before you leave Marheim.
"I'm afraid I cannot help you, young man. I already gave the golden statue to the other young man.
"If you could rescue the king's daughter," said Lord Trane, "The King's courage would be restored."
"Sorry, I have no use for it."
"The dragon's cave is directly north of here." said the ranger."
"Alms! Alms for the poor!"
"I have a prophecy for you, m'lord." said the beggar. "You must seek two women, one Good, one Evil."
"Lovely Jewels, glint in the night - give to us the gift of Sight!" he said.
"Where is the hidden city? How can you find it when you cannot even see it?" said the beggar.
"Kind deeds could gain thee a friend from the sea."
"Seek the place that is darker than night - There you shall find your goal in sight!" said the wizard, cryptically.
"Like the eye itself, a crystal Orb can help to find things concealed."
"The Witch lives in the dim forest of Grimwood, where the very trees are warped to her will. Her gaze is Death!"
"Only the light of the Sun can destroy the Witch's Evil."
"The maiden you seek lies imprisoned in an unreachable castle surrounded by unclimbable mountains."
"Tame the golden beast and no mountain may deny you! But what rope could hold such a creature?"
"Just what I needed!" he said.
"Away with you, young ruffian!" said the Wizard. "Perhaps you can find some small animal to torment if that pleases you!"
"You must seek your enemy on the spirit plane. It is hazardous in the extreme. Space may twist, and time itself may run backwards!"
"When you wish to travel quickly, seek the power of the Stones." he said.
"Since you are brave of heart, I shall Heal all your wounds."Instantly % felt much better.
"Ah! You have a writ from the king. Here is one of the golden statues of Azal-Car-Ithil. Find all five and you'll find the vanishing city."
"Repent, Sinner! Thou art an uncouth brute and I have no interest in your conversation!"
"Ho there, young traveler!" said the black figure. "None may enter the sacred shrine of the People who came Before!"
"Your prowess in battle is great." said the Knight of Dreams. "You have earned the right to enter and claim the prize."
"So this is the so-called Hero who has been sent to hinder my plans. Simply Pathetic. Well, try this, young Fool!"
% gasped. The Necromancer had been transformed into a normal man. All of his evil was gone.
"%." said the Sorceress. "Welcome. Here is one of the five golden figurines you will need.""Thank you." said %.
"Look into my eyes and Die!!" hissed the witch."Not a chance!" replied %
The Spectre spoke. "HE has usurped my place as lord of undead. Bring me bones of the ancient King and I'll help you destroy him."
% gave him the ancient bones."Good! That spirit now rests quietly in my halls. Take this crystal shard."
"%..." said the apparition. "I am the ghost of your dead brother. Find my bones -- there you will find some things you need.
% gave him some gold coins. "Why, thank you, young sir!"
"Sorry, but I have nothing to sell."
"The dragon's cave is east of here." said the ranger."
"The dragon's cave is west of here." said the ranger."
"The dragon's cave is south of here." said the ranger."
"Oh, thank you for saving my eggs, kind man!" said the turtle. "Take this seashell as a token of my gratitude."
"Just hop on my back if you need a ride somewhere." said the turtle.
"Stupid fool, you can't hurt me with that!"
"Your magic won't work here, fool!"
The Sunstone has made the witch vulnerable!
